# How to Update GitHub Repository Description

This document explains how to apply the suggested repository description and topics to your GitHub repository.

## Step 1: Update Repository Description

1. Go to your repository on GitHub: https://github.com/OriBraverman/PacmanGame
2. Click the "⚙️ Settings" tab (you need admin/owner access)
3. Scroll down to the "General" section
4. In the "Repository name" section, you'll find a "Description" field
5. Copy and paste this description:

```
C++ Pacman game with advanced AI strategies, save/load functionality, and multi-level support. Features intelligent ghost behavior using BFS algorithms, complete gameplay recording system, and console-based interface.
```

## Step 2: Add Repository Topics

1. On the main repository page (https://github.com/OriBraverman/PacmanGame)
2. Look for the "About" section in the right sidebar
3. Click the "⚙️" gear icon next to "About"
4. In the "Topics" section, add these topics (one by one):

```
pacman
game
cpp
artificial-intelligence
bfs-algorithm
console-game
strategy-pattern
object-oriented
breadth-first-search
game-recording
save-load
multi-level
windows
visual-studio
```

## Step 3: Optional - Add Website/Homepage

If you have a website or want to link to anything specific, you can add it in the "Website" field in the About section.

## Result

After these changes, your repository will have:
- A clear, descriptive title that appears under the repository name
- Relevant topics that help people discover your project
- Better searchability and categorization on GitHub

The description and topics accurately reflect your project's key features:
- C++ implementation
- Advanced AI with BFS algorithms  
- Save/load functionality
- Multi-level support
- Console-based interface
- Object-oriented design with strategy patterns
